issues.t: CVT jerks, slips or loses power
issues.sym: Jerking or shuddering when pulling away, the engine revving without the car speeding up, hesitation, limp mode, or a whine that gets worse in hot weather.
issues.why: The Kicks uses a continuously variable transmission (CVT). Owners report slipping, shudder and some outright failures, sometimes after the fluid has overheated on long, hot highway drives.
issues.next: Have the CVT fluid checked and ask a dealer for any transmission software updates. If it slips or shudders, get it diagnosed before it fails completely, and ask about warranty coverage.

issues.t: Engine stalls at stops or while driving
issues.sym: The engine dies at a stop light or shuts off while moving, may be hard to restart, idles rough, and often sets a check engine light with code P0101.
issues.why: Owners and shops have traced many cases to the mass airflow (MAF) sensor that measures incoming air, a dirty or failing electronic throttle body, or engine computer software.
issues.next: Have the codes read as soon as it happens. Ask the shop to check the airflow sensor, intake leaks and the throttle body, and to look for software updates before replacing parts repeatedly.

issues.t: Emergency braking activates or warns for no reason
issues.sym: Forward collision or emergency braking warnings appear with nothing ahead, the car brakes hard on its own, or the system shuts off and cruise control stops working.
issues.why: The automatic emergency braking (AEB) system uses a front radar and camera. False detections, a dirty sensor or a fault can trigger warnings or unexpected braking.
issues.next: Keep the front sensor and windshield area clean, and have a dealer check for codes and software updates. Report unexpected braking to NHTSA.

issues.t: ABS light from failed ABS actuator
issues.sym: The ABS warning light stays on, sometimes with other traction or brake warnings, and in some cases stalling at stops.
issues.why: The ABS actuator and control unit (the pump and valve block that pulses the brakes) can fail. Owners report long waits for replacement parts.
issues.next: Your normal brakes usually still work, but anti-lock and stability control may not. Have the ABS codes read and get it repaired soon.

issues.t: A/C struggles in hot weather
issues.sym: The air conditioning cools fine on mild days but blows only cool air when it is very hot outside or when sitting in traffic.
issues.why: Owners report weak A/C performance in high heat. Nissan published a bulletin with a fix for some cars; a low or overfilled refrigerant charge or a blocked condenser can also cause it.
issues.next: Have the refrigerant charge checked (not just topped off) and the condenser cleaned. Ask a dealer whether the A/C bulletin (NTB19-041) applies.

issues.t: Windshield cracks without impact
issues.sym: Cracks appear in the windshield with no clear rock strike, or the windshield needs replacing more than once. Some leak.
issues.why: Owners of both generations report windshields cracking easily. Replacement also usually means recalibrating the front camera used by driver-assist features.
issues.next: Check whether your insurance has glass coverage. Make sure the shop recalibrates the windshield camera after replacement.

issues.t: Coil springs break
issues.sym: A loud clunk or bang, the car sitting lower at one corner, or a rattling over bumps.
issues.why: Owners report front and rear coil springs and strut hardware breaking.
issues.next: Look under the car at the low corner. A broken spring can cut a tire, so have it replaced promptly, ideally in pairs.

issues.t: Touchscreen freezes and CarPlay drops
issues.sym: The center screen freezes or reboots, and Apple CarPlay or Android Auto disconnects.
issues.why: Software glitches in the infotainment unit and USB connection problems. RepairPal also lists front USB ports failing as a common Kicks complaint.
issues.next: Try a different good-quality cable and a system restart, then ask a dealer for software updates.

issues.t: Wanders in crosswinds at highway speed
issues.sym: At highway speeds, light crosswinds push the car around and the steering feels loose, so you have to hold the wheel tightly.
issues.why: Owners report this on this tall, light crossover. Alignment and tire condition can make it worse.
issues.next: Check tire pressures and have the alignment and front suspension checked.

issues.t: Steering feels heavy and doesn't center
issues.sym: The steering feels stiff and does not return to center on its own after a turn.
issues.why: This was the most-reported complaint for the 2025 Kicks on CarComplaints. Owners also report a telescoping wheel that moves or pops.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the steering column and alignment and look for software updates.

issues.t: Pulls to one side and wears tires
issues.sym: The car pulls to one side or wobbles, and the tires wear unevenly early.
issues.why: Owners of the 2025 Kicks report alignment problems, including faulty rear camber, causing uneven tire wear.
issues.next: Have the alignment checked early, while it may still be covered under the new car warranty.

issues.t: Backup camera image can be left switched off (recall)
issues.sym: No picture appears on the screen in Reverse after someone changed the display settings.
issues.why: The camera display settings can be changed so the image is hidden, and the setting is kept. Recall 19V654.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. The dealer software update is free.

issues.t: Power steering assist can cut out (recall)
issues.sym: The steering suddenly becomes very heavy and the power steering warning light comes on.
issues.why: An intermittent connection in the electric power steering torque sensor can switch off power assist. Recalls 22V693 and 23V496.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. The dealer replaces the steering column if needed.

issues.t: Driver airbag may deploy improperly (recall)
issues.sym: No warning signs before a crash.
issues.why: A manufacturing flaw can let moisture into the driver airbag inflator so it may not deploy correctly. Recall 24V154 covers a small number of vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. The dealer replaces the driver airbag free.

issues.t: No warning when shut off out of Park (recall)
issues.sym: No chime or warning when you switch the car off in Drive or Neutral, so it could roll away.
issues.why: The body control module may not trigger the shift-to-Park warning. Recall 24V969.
issues.next: Always confirm the car is in Park and set the parking brake. Check your VIN for the recall.

issues.t: Wrong weight rating on door label (recall)
issues.sym: Nothing you will feel. The door jamb label lists the wrong weight ratings, and some SR models with 19-inch wheels list the wrong wheel size.
issues.why: Incorrect certification label values could lead to overloading or wrong tire pressures. Recall 25V188.
issues.next: Check your VIN. The dealer fits a corrected label free.

issues.t: Screen goes blank in Reverse (recall)
issues.sym: The center screen goes blank when you shift into Reverse, so the backup camera image does not show.
issues.why: A software problem with the center display. Recall 25V324.
issues.next: Check your VIN. The dealer software update is free.

issues.t: Instrument display can go blank (recall)
issues.sym: The digital gauge display goes partly or fully blank, often on a cold start, hiding your speed and warning lights.
issues.why: A software error in the instrument cluster (combination meter). Recall 26V331.
issues.next: Check your VIN and get the free software update. Drive with extra care until then.

issues.t: Door strikers can break (recall)
issues.sym: A door does not latch firmly or feels loose when closed.
issues.why: Poor welds on the door strikers can let them break, which could allow a door to open while driving. Recall 26V023.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the strikers replaced free.

issues.t: Front seat frame may loosen (recall)
issues.sym: The front seat feels loose or moves.
issues.why: Weak welds on a seat frame hook bracket can let the seat loosen. Recall 26V145 covers a very small number of cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN. The dealer replaces the seat free.
